issues.problem: Canonical documents are in the separate i-pp/ai-orchestration repository. A pre-existing local checkout is available.
issues.impact: Do not duplicate common policy text in the runtime repository.
issues.workaround: Read the pinned commit/hash through the existing local Git checkout, recording local commit/origin/dirty independently.
issues.revisit_when: The canonical revision or local source configuration changes.

issues.problem: Only the original completed slot is approved in the live allowlist.
issues.impact: A different normal task cannot be registered yet.
issues.workaround: Prepared a default-OFF bounded workstream grant instead of endless per-slot additions; live adapter is not connected.
issues.revisit_when: Exact workstream scope, limits, validity, return retention and cancellation/deployment path are approved.

issues.problem: The parent dot catalog has not exposed the four mailbox tools.
issues.workaround: Use the explicitly identified local Codex MCP stdio route and keep hosted/direct claims separate.
issues.revisit_when: A supported catalog refresh exposes the tools to dot and a direct read succeeds.

issues.problem: The mailbox cannot start a resting Chat.
issues.impact: Pure dot-to-Chat autonomous initiation is incomplete.
issues.workaround: Use the existing authorized Codex send route only for specifically authorized requests.
issues.revisit_when: A supported authorized Chat initiation interface is available.

issues.problem: Initial publication to the existing private i-pp/agent-orchestrator was explicitly authorized. The prior local history contains personal absolute paths.
issues.impact: Do not import unnecessary historical machine paths.
issues.workaround: Publish only the reviewed portable working-tree snapshot through the existing connected GitHub account; retain the original local history and index.
issues.revisit_when: Initial private publication and branch/commit/file readback are verified.
